eslint_output: (none)

ESLint block-scoped-var reports variable.references outside the declaring block; a bare declaration or a parameter creates no reference. oxlint block_scoped_var.rs run_for_all_redeclarations() reports every redeclaration span outside the block, the original parameter included, as a stand-in for initializer write references (its comment: "we can't find the reference of 'a' by call get_resolved_references so I use symbol_redeclarations").
